name: Base React/Next.js — wagmi + viem
role: LegioX truth lens — Ring Base L2 secondary rail

mission.primary_objective: Wire wagmi + viem for Base (chainId 8453 / 84532) reusing ring-platform.org EVM stack, with AA paymaster path when gasless US rail is enabled.
mission.context: Legacy ring-platform.org uses wagmi for Polygon; Base rail adds base + baseSepolia to wagmi config when ring-config.chains.evm.base.enabled. Solana native wallet is separate provider tree — do not merge. Gasless path delegates to base-account-smart-wallet + paymaster lenses.
mission.target_outcome: configureChains includes base; useWriteContract targets RING mirror address from ring-config; readContract for 8-decimal balances; optional useSendUserOperation when CDP AA enabled.
mission.scope: Next.js wagmi/viem for Base rail only. Excludes Solana wallet-adapter (solana-react-next-wallet-integration) and full multichain Polygon primary flows.

truth_lens: Base wagmi integration extends existing EVM provider — add base and baseSepolia chains, RING mirror ABI with 8 decimals in formatUnits. ring-config.chains.evm.base.ringTokenAddress is SSOT for contract address. For gasless US users, wagmi alone is insufficient — route to CDP smart account + paymaster. Keep Web3Provider client boundary; dynamic import to save bundle size. Never treat Base as ring-native chain in UI copy.
core_principles: ring-config SSOT for Base chainId and RING mirror address.
Separate Solana and EVM wallet UI sections.
AA gasless path via paymaster lens — not plain useWriteContract alone.
Reuse existing web3-provider.tsx patterns from Polygon legacy.
anti_patterns: Hardcoding Base RING address outside ring-config.
Single wallet provider mixing Solana adapter + wagmi without chain tabs.
Enabling Base as default chain over Solana native.
Client-side CDP paymaster URL in wagmi transport config.
key_patterns: wagmi config: import { base, baseSepolia } from 'wagmi/chains'.
useReadContract({ address: ringConfig.evm.base.ringToken, abi: erc20Abi, functionName: 'balanceOf' }).
useWriteContract for non-sponsored power-user path only.
useSendUserOperation when smartAccount enabled in config.
wallet-wrapper.tsx: conditional Base section if chains.evm.base.enabled.
hooks/use-wallet-balance.ts: branch chain === 'base' for mirror read.
consult_when: Displaying RING mirror balance on Base in wallet UI.
Integrating CDP AA with existing wagmi hooks.
Porting Polygon wagmi patterns to Base Sepolia testnet.
